manifest.title: Baseball Pitching Analyzer
manifest.author: bstrana
manifest.description: Real-time baseball pitching and swing mechanics analysis, powered by TensorFlow.js pose detection running entirely in the browser. Track pitching and hitting mechanics live from your webcam — all processing happens client-side in the browser; no server-side processing or account is required.
manifest.tagline: Real-time baseball pitching & swing mechanics analysis
manifest.postInstallMessage: The app is a static, client-side tool - no database or account setup is required. Open the app URL and grant camera access when your browser prompts for it (pose tracking runs locally in your browser). If the camera permission is denied, enable it in the browser site settings.

manifest.title: Baseball Pitching Analyzer
manifest.author: bstrana
manifest.description: Real-time baseball pitching and swing mechanics analysis, powered by TensorFlow.js pose detection running entirely in the browser. Track pitching and hitting mechanics live from your webcam — all processing happens client-side in the browser. Sign-in via Keycloak is required.
manifest.tagline: Real-time baseball pitching & swing mechanics analysis
manifest.changelog: Add required Keycloak sign-in. Configure via /app/data/config.env (KEYCLOAK_URL, KEYCLOAK_REALM, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID) and restart the app.
manifest.postInstallMessage: This app requires Keycloak sign-in. Create a client for this app in your Keycloak realm, then edit /app/data/config.env (KEYCLOAK_URL, KEYCLOAK_REALM, KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID) and restart the app from the Cloudron dashboard. Until then, the app shows a 'sign-in not configured' message.
